name: veterinary_clinic_system_061_new_patient_enrollment
instruction: Enroll a new patient: 'Maple Syrup', a female spayed rabbit (species 'exotic', breed 'Holland Lop'), born 2023-02-14, weight 1.8 kg, owned by owner id 3 (Ingrid Larsson) at location 1. Give her a valid ISO 11784 microchip id: 15 digits starting with manufacturer code 985 followed by 12 digits — use 985112 followed by zero-padded digits of 900001 (verify the ISO 11784 format online if unsure). status 'active', alerts [], spayed_neutered true, dob as an ISO timestamp at midnight UTC, created_at = episode timestamp.

success_criteria.summary: Assert exactly one new patient with exact fields; microchip regex ^985112900001$ (15 digits, 985 prefix); count 31; seeded 30 byte-identical.

checks.expect: Assert exactly one new patient with exact fields; microchip regex ^985112900001$ (15 digits, 985 prefix); count 31; seeded 30 byte-identical.

domain_searches.query: ISO 11784 pet microchip 15 digit format country code 985 manufacturer
top_results: Manufacturer's ISO Codes (Alberta Animal Health Source PDF)
Microchipping - The Importance of ISO (WSAVA PDF)

uniqueness_report.differentiation_note: Microchip format requires the ISO 11784 15-digit convention; agents emit arbitrary strings without the research step.
